questions.question: Identify the variables and constants in P = 2l + 2b and explain the roles of the variables.
questions.expected_answer: Variables P, l and b; constants 2 and 2. P is the subject or output, calculated from the inputs l and b. The twos are fixed because every rectangle has two lengths and two breadths.

questions.question: Why is π a constant in A = πr² even though it is written as a letter?
questions.expected_answer: π has one fixed value, about 3,142, for every circle; it is written as a letter because its decimal never ends. A and r change from circle to circle, so they are the variables.

questions.question: How does the formula C = 8k + 12 become the equation 8k + 12 = 60, and what changes about the roles of the letters?
questions.expected_answer: C is given the value 60 for one particular trip. C stops being a variable and becomes a known constant for that trip; k becomes the unknown to be solved, giving k = 6.
